metadata.name: Alt-Lite
metadata.description: A loose online right-wing movement stressing national identity, immigration limits and opposition to political correctness while publicly distancing itself from explicit racial supremacism.
metadata.scope: Provisional AI assessment of Alt-Lite; North American online movement, c. 2016–2018. Keep the 2016–2018 loose movement distinct from racial supremacism. Claimed speech freedom and order preferences conflict; national identity is not evidence for inherited racial violence. Online activity does not settle biomedical ethics. Every question has a most-likely interpretation, disclosed as an inferred educated assumption; exact response strength and historical applications remain estimates. This is a distinct same-agent assessment/review, not external peer certification or a survey of adherents.
metadata.phrase: Society should prioritise national cultural identity, restrict immigration and resist progressive cultural demands while defending the movement’s conception of free expression.
